description: Search Rhea, the expert-curated database of biochemical reactions (the reaction reference used by UniProt and KEGG). Find enzyme/metabolic reactions by compound name, ChEBI id, EC number, or keyword and get the balanced plain-text reaction equation plus EC and ChEBI cross-references. Keyless.

query.description: Compound name, ChEBI id, EC number (e.g. "1.1.1.1"), UniProt accession, or free-text keyword.
